subject: An error related to `dplyr` package when deploying Shiny app to Shinyapps.io

messages.author: f7d56dedd8804193
messages.subject: An error related to `dplyr` package when deploying Shiny app to Shinyapps.io
parts:
I have a Shiny app that uses the following packages in the server.R file.

library(shiny)      
library(ggplot2)    
library(plyr)       
library(reshape2)
library(scales)
library(grid)
library(data.table)
library(pracma)
library(dplyr)

The app runs without any errors inside Rstudio; however, it gave an error (below) when I tried to upload it to my account at shinyapps.io. It seems that the error is related to the dplyr package. It uploads successfully when I remove the  dplyr package. I need the dplyr and plyr package to do some calculations in the server.R script.

Here is the error that I've got in Rstudio upon uploading the Shiny app:

library(shinyapps)

messages.subject: Re: An error related to `dplyr` package when deploying Shiny app to Shinyapps.io
parts: Just found what the issue was. The dplyr package needs the Rccp package to be installed. I did that and I was able to upload it successfully.
